+"""Interactive RCB-limited controller for the BEHAVIOR-1K Christmas task.
+
+Start with ``python -i /app/output/gen.py``.  The ``s`` session object keeps
+one Robot client and saves each observation/action result under /app/runs.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+
+class Session:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.r = Robot(timeout=600)
+        Path("/app/output").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        Path("/app/runs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        Path("/app/output/spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(self.r.spec(), indent=2))
+        self.obs = self.r.get_obs(video="frames")
+        self.n = 0
+        self.obs.save("/app/runs/000_initial")
+        self._report("initial", self.obs.meta)
+
+    def _report(self, label, meta):
+        print(label, {k: meta.get(k) for k in
+                      ("step", "control_steps", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s", "done", "reason")
+                      if k in meta}, flush=True)
+
+    def observe(self, seconds=0.0, video="frames"):
+        self.obs = self.r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)
+        self.n += 1
+        self.obs.save(f"/app/runs/{self.n:03d}_observe")
+        self._report("observe", self.obs.meta)
+        return self.obs
+
+    def joint(self, x=0.0, y=0.0, yaw=0.0, dt=0.5, note=""):
+        """Apply one short base increment while holding the measured joints."""
+        q = np.asarray(self.obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+        # The first 3 proprio joints are the head; q[3:25] are the 22
+        # controllable trunk/arm/finger joints in the action block order.
+        a = np.zeros(25, dtype=np.float32)
+        a[:3] = (x, y, yaw)
+        a[3:] = q[3:25]
+        result = self.r.submit("joint_position", a, dt=dt, video="mp4", note=note)
+        self.n += 1
+        result.save(f"/app/runs/{self.n:03d}_joint")
+        self.obs = self.r.get_obs(video="frames")
+        self._report("joint", result.meta)
+        return result
+
+    def ee(self, left=None, right=None, left_gripper=1.0, right_gripper=1.0, note=""):
+        """Move both hands to world-frame xyz+xyzw poses (unspecified hand holds pose)."""
+        p = np.asarray(self.obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+        if left is None:
+            left = p[35:42]
+        if right is None:
+            right = p[42:49]
+        a = np.asarray([*left, left_gripper, *right, right_gripper], dtype=np.float32)
+        result = self.r.submit("ee_pose", a, video="mp4", note=note)
+        self.n += 1
+        result.save(f"/app/runs/{self.n:03d}_ee")
+        self.obs = self.r.get_obs(video="frames")
+        self._report("ee", result.meta)
+        return result
+
+
+s = Session()
